{{Top|leg}}
The '''Central Directories''' on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]] were a series of interconnected databases that compiled information from [[City/Legends|cities]]  across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Directories included census data, including names and addresses; financial information on income, sales, and employment data; and genealogical information such as [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Marriage/Legends|bonding]], and [[Divorce/Legends|dissolution]] records. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]] obtained information from the [[Recorder of Assignments and Transactions for the Supervisor's Committee]], a [[TT-40 librarian droid]] in the city of [[Griann]], that allowed them to continue searching for a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] sect.<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
